title: blepharis inermis
intro: Blepharis inermis, commonly known as Ironplume or Desert Tebb, is a perennial herbaceous plant belonging to the family Acanthaceae. It is native to the tropical and subtropical regions of Africa and Asia. The health benefits of Blepharis inermis include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve wound healing due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties.
